levels.label: 4 — No reduction
levels.description: Nothing is changed. The control this pack is measured against.

levels.label: 3 — Light reduction
levels.description: Shorter reasoning summaries. Output length unchanged.
levels.instruction: Reduce token usage: trim filler and avoid restating what was just said. Keep reasoning and explanations otherwise full.

levels.label: 2 — Moderate reduction
levels.description: Shorter output and shorter reasoning summaries, capped rather than asked for.
levels.instruction: Reduce token usage: give shorter explanations and terser output throughout this session.

levels.label: 1 — Heavy reduction
levels.description: Low verbosity, no reasoning summaries, and compaction before the window fills.
levels.instruction: Reduce token usage heavily: keep narration minimal, state results and decisions directly, skip recaps and closing summaries.

levels.label: 0 — Maximum reduction
levels.description: Low verbosity, no summaries, reduced reasoning effort, answers only.
levels.instruction: Reduce token usage to the maximum: answer as tersely as possible, with no narration and no explanation unless one is asked for.
